description: On the bed in front of you are two small white drawer-like pieces, one stacked on another, near a pink pillow. The right hand grips the knob of the lower drawer piece and slides it toward the stacked piece while the left hand steadies the top piece; then both hands align the two parts and press them together so they sit stacked neatly, with the right hand still holding the front knob as the left hand rests along the side to keep it from shifting.
